race.comment: SAISOKU (1) is racing well without winning, just missing over this track and trip last week on a heavy deck. A bubble cheeker goes on today and that should help him straight in the run home. Was an odds-on pop there and looks to be knocking on the door of a maiden win. Can get the job done this time. RUTHLESS BLOOM (9) steps out in trip today for just the second time and she's showing good promise. The inside draw is a big tick and she raced well here two back. Can sit handy from the outset and be in this race for a very long way. FOREVER VICTORIOUS (8) missed here first-up but was much better last time out at Pinjarra when sitting up front over this trip. CJP sticks with her as she comes here third-up with a strong figure behind her. Leading chance. MAGNIFICENT PRINCE (12) steps right out in trip today and an improved run is on the cards. MODERN MISS (11) was off a long break first-up and is expected to be better on the back of that.
